description: Pebbled black under a net of branching cyan that will not sit still. Warm. Its spark rarely stops at one body.
lore: In the graders' register, the ground a stone comes off and the nature it grades to are two columns saying one thing — black rock, fire; high snow, frost. This is the line where the columns disagree: it comes down off [[monsters/snow_demon|the Frostwraith]]'s snow, many days uphill, and it grades storm. [[characters/a6d7323d|Gunnar]] brings most of them down. He sells the stones readily and the places he found them not at all, which people take for a wanderer's habit, and which is actually arithmetic he does not like.

They fetch more than anything else off that mountain, and the first thing anyone learns fighting with one is not to let a friend stand at their shoulder: the spark goes where it is sent, and then sometimes it is in the next body along, whichever body that is. [[characters/646b922c|Sigrun]] will set one — for the price they carry she can hardly refuse — but she asks a single question first, who do you fight beside, and there are answers she hands the stone back over. Asked for her reasoning, she taps the head of her hammer and does not give it.
